I replied to Marcus in the thread on his #north-team message. I told him the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date is 27 January.

- **Where that date comes from:** On 14 Oct, Dana gave 7 July and I recorded that date. Later the same day she posted a correction in #north-random: 27 January, saying she'd read the wrong line. Marcus is in #north-random, so he can see that correction himself.
- **What I couldn't confirm:** I found the correction in the knowledge brain, but it didn't show up when I read #north-random directly. There's also no Brackenwater contract in the shared files to check the date against. I suggested he confirm it with Dana.
- **What still needs fixing:** The brain still has 7 July filed under the Brackenwater account. The correction is linked to that entry, but I haven't updated the entry itself.
